data.description:
## Description

**What**: Ships migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh and wires it into the Migration Check block of 7 skills.
**Why**: Existing consumer projects need an automated path from design-notes.md to the new DESIGN.md format.
**Scope**:
- IN: Migration script, section mapping, deprecation tombstone, migration marker, greenfield guard, Migration Check block wiring in 7 skills, spec-compliance verification
- OUT: Reference retargeting (draft-7), audit command (draft-7)

## Done Definitions

- plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh exists with executable bit set, maps each design-notes.md section to the corresponding DESIGN.md section per the established mapping, and prepends empty token YAML front-matter ← Satisfies: sc-4 (sc-4: "Migration with spec-compliance verification")
- The script leaves .claude/design-notes.md as a deprecation tombstone with a migration marker after successful migration ← Satisfies: sc-4
- The script refuses to create a DESIGN.md with empty token YAML front-matter on a greenfield project lacking .claude/design-notes.md (exits cleanly with no file written) ← Satisfies: sc-4
- The Migration Check block invokes migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh in exactly these 7 skills: onboarding, brainstorm, sprint, preplanning, fix-bug, roadmap, and debug-everything. Each block is idempotent and marker-gated ← Satisfies: sc-4
- The resulting DESIGN.md passes npx --yes @google/design.md@<pinned-version> lint DESIGN.md with zero structural errors when exercised against a migration fixture ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Idempotency] The migration marker prevents double-migration; the script must be safe to invoke multiple times.
- [Section mapping] The mapping must handle all known design-notes.md section variants (color palette, typography, spacing, component library, etc.).
- [Greenfield guard] The greenfield check prevents creating a hollow DESIGN.md that would confuse the linter into thinking the project has a design system.
- [Consumer Impact] plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md writes .claude/design-notes.md for new UI projects. After migration, newly onboarded projects should write DESIGN.md directly, not design-notes.md followed by immediate migration. Coordinate with draft-7 to update onboarding to write DESIGN.md directly.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO consumer with an existing design-notes.md, I want an automated migration to a spec-compliant DESIGN.md, so that I get design-system linting without manual conversion.
